Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Rishabh - 9 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Pallavi - 35 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Kunal - 10 years, friend
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
4. Sharda - 71 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Rishabh stands in the courtyard. Pallavi stands near him.]

Rishabh: "What lovely weather!"

[Rishabh bursts out laughing.]

Rishabh: "How beautiful!"

[Rishabh starts crying.]

Pallavi (gently): "Hey, look at that!"

[Rishabh smiles at Mother.]

Rishabh: "Show me too!"

[Rishabh stamps his foot in anger.]

Pallavi (excited): "Hmm, I see."

[Rishabh gets frightened and steps back.]

Rishabh: "That was such a fun day!"
